tier_1.name: Tier 1: Automated Digital Nudge
tier_1.operational_action: Automated empathetic email/push notification with study planning checklist and direct forum links
tier_1.empirical_evidence: Shi et al. (2024); Gatare et al. (2023)

tier_2.name: Tier 2: Intensive Academic Advisor Outreach
tier_2.theoretical_framework: Tinto Student Integration & Academic Momentum Theory
tier_2.operational_action: Personal advisor telephone/email outreach under 48h priority; diagnostic scaffolding, grace periods
tier_2.empirical_evidence: Rust & Motz RCT (2020); Alalawi et al. (2024)

tier_3.name: Tier 3: Adaptive Curricular Scaffolding
tier_3.theoretical_framework: Cognitive Load Theory (Sweller, 2011) & Instructional Design Loop Closure
tier_3.operational_action: Modular remedial concept walkthroughs, peer mentoring recommendations, and formative self-assessment quizzes
